alcance: Logical PostgreSQL comparison. Backup verification also requires a physical restore, files and a VEC startup check.
igual: The checked inventories and contents match. Continue the remaining backup checks.
diferente: The restored inventories differ. Do not mark the backup as valid; review the reasons and repeat the corrected trial.
no_comprobable: The inventory is incomplete or contains objects unsupported by this reader. Complete their verification before validating the backup.
captura_completada: Logical inventory captured. Keep the file protected with the evidence that writers were excluded.
copias_contraste_error_argumentos: The arguments are incomplete or do not match the selected mode. Check the help and repeat the command.
copias_contraste_error_catalogo: The full message catalogue could not be read. Check the file for the selected language.
copias_contraste_error_entrada: A valid inventory could not be read. Check the file format and size.
copias_contraste_error_configuracion: The configuration is invalid. Check the private connection, PostgreSQL version, limits and declared references.
copias_contraste_error_captura: The PostgreSQL read could not be completed. Check the isolated target and its permissions, then repeat the capture.
copias_contraste_error_salida: The result could not be written. Check the output destination and repeat the command.
ayuda: Capture: --modo capturar --configuracion FILE --catalogo CATALOGUE. Compare: --modo comparar --esperado INVENTORY --observado INVENTORY --catalogo CATALOGUE. Capture requires an isolated PostgreSQL 18 target in read-only mode with no writers. Files contain private evidence. Exit 0: complete capture or equality; 1: difference or not verifiable; 2: error.
